lucia.visualDescription: Original casual outfit: a short cream cardigan over a pale-lavender blouse, dark violet pleated skirt, white ankle socks and violet loafers. Keep her pale-silver side buns, violet hair ribbons and clear cyan eyes. A small violet shoulder bag has a tiny pink crystal clasp. Carry her recognizable ornate silver-and-violet long-barrel musket with a shoulder stock, held low beside the body; no pair of short pistols. Earnest lively expression with raised inner brows and a small open mouth. This is a newly designed fan casual outfit, not an official skin.

ceres.visualDescription: Original casual outfit: a soft ivory ribbed turtleneck, short slate-blue open jacket, dark navy tailored shorts over charcoal tights, and simple black ankle boots. Keep her neat silver bob and narrow pale-blue eyes with flat upper lids, straight low brows and a composed stern closed mouth. Replace the maid lace headpiece with a plain narrow black hairband. Carry her recognizable black-and-gold greatsword with one magenta crystal near the guard, resting diagonally beside the body without hiding the face. This is a newly designed fan casual outfit, not an official skin.

craver.visualDescription: Original casual outfit: a light-gray open bomber jacket over a burgundy hoodie, charcoal cargo trousers, black-and-red sneakers and dark fingerless gloves. Preserve his messy spiky vivid red-black hair, round red-tinted spectacles over sharply narrow amber eyes, low stern brows and cold straight mouth. Hold his recognizable large black-and-red revolver low, with a visible cylinder and no glow effects replacing its silhouette. This is a newly designed fan casual outfit, not an official skin.
